# About Me

Hello!! My name is Niangh Huai Ciang and I am from Glasgow.

# Favorite Sport

My favourite sport is badminton. I always play with my brother after we have dinner, and it has become a special routine for us. I like this because it helps me relax, have fun, spend quality time with my family, and it’s also really good for my health.

# Favorite Food

My favourite food is Sushi. I enjoy it because every piece tastes different, and I love the mix of textures. It’s also a food that feels clean and refreshing to eat.

# Favourite Song

I am a big fan of music, and I love listening to different genres. My favourite artist is Taylor Swift, and “Anti‑Hero” is one of my favourite songs by her.

# Interesting fact about me

An interesting fact about me is that I am a hardworking person who never gives up easily. I adapt quickly to new situations, and even when things feel difficult, I always try to go with the flow and find a solution. I am kind‑hearted, and I always respect other people.
